messages:
Gabe: FYI, new SI (Polaris Tech) asked for a live-fire onboarding walkthrough focused on marketplace listing, SI badge, and go/no-go signals. Can we run at 11:00 PT tomorrow?
Tori: 11:00 PT works. I9ll bring the marketing checklist and the badge artwork.
Liam: I9m in. Will prep the SKU manifest and the ingestion smoke tests. Recommend staging run only, then controlled flag flip.
ops-bot: Flag found: `polaris_si_publish` default=false. API: POST /flags/polaris_si_publish {"value":"true"}.
Gabe: Decision: pre-provision partners-only badge; flip to public during the run. Ops must provide rollback script and CDN purge step.
Tori: Marketing needs the final partner quote + 3 screenshots by 09:30 PT to assemble assets. Share under embargo.
Liam: SKUs for Polaris: POL-EDGE-1, POL-GPU-4, POL-ACC-L. Demo env: staging-polaris-2026.
Gabe: Include a simulated ingestion failure in the run so partner sees rollback and comms. Short customer-facing message template required.
partner-pm: We9d like the recovery flow included. Also want timeline published after rehearsal.
Liam: Runbook sketch: 1) intros 11:00, 2) demo 11:05, 3) flip & CDN purge 11:15, 4) simulate failure & rollback 11:17, 5) partner Q&A + sign-off 11:30.
ops-bot: Suggested rollback command: POST /flags/polaris_si_publish {"value":"false"}; POST /cdn/purge {"paths":["/marketplace/tiles/polaris"]}.
Tori: Noted. I9ll prepare embargoed copy and the social asset pack. Send it to partner under NDA only.
Gabe: Great. Drop the deck and one-pager in the calendar invite before EOD. Keep comments short during the run.
partner-pm: Thanks, see you tomorrow 11:00 PT.
Liam: \ud83d\udc4d
